# Chapter 2: Time

## 2.1 Waiting

> The rest window is the time dough needs between folds.

**Oven spring** is the last rise the loaf makes in the heat of the oven [Nob20].

The rise speed depends on the room, and careful timing matters more than any tool
[Kel17, p. 12].

## Summary

Wait for the rest window, then fold.
